messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx rate detected for hosted inference (us-west-2) on /v1/generate. Error spike started ~4625004280, current 5xx ~12% over 5m. Severity: P2. @maya oncall
maya: seeing it, thanks. pulling up dashboards now.
maya: sam can you confirm infra load? I see queue depth rising on runtime pool A
sam: checking nodes in pool-A. GPU utilization 86%, queue length spiking, a few hosts showing prolonged GC churn
oliver: runtime traces show backlog in KV cache attachment + long tail for streaming sessions. suspect per-tenant in-flight spikes + some large seq requests
maya: prelim mitigation proposals: 1) apply short-lived per-customer rate limit 2) reduce max_in_flight for pool-A 3) disable streaming on embeddings route for hosted account tier. thoughts?
sam: we can push a ratecap rule quickly via traffic-shaper: set global token_rate 2000r/s -> 1500r/s and add per-tenant burst cap 50 requests/min for top noisy tenants
oliver: lowering max_in_flight from 48 -> 32 on pool-A should reduce head-of-line blocking. also recommend dropping connection_write_timeout from 45s -> 20s to free stalled sessions
jess: heads-up: Support seeing some customers already reporting errors. I'll post a proactive update if we put in a customer-facing mitigation
eva: if we throttle heavy tenants we should notify account owners (I'll coordinate msgs). Prefer to avoid disabling features if possible
maya: executing plan: 1) sam apply temporary traffic-shaper rule (15m) 2) oliver reduce max_in_flight on pool-A 3) oliver disable streaming for /v1/embeddings-hosted on the tiered route 4) jess craft quick banner
sam: applying rule now: `traffic-shaper apply --env prod --region us-west-2 --rule 'global_rate=1500; tenant_burst=50' --ttl 15m`
sam: rule applied ✅
maya: oliver, please roll the runtime change
oliver: rolling max_in_flight change via canary on 10% nodes then 100% if green. command: ```kubectl set env deploy/runtime-pool-a MAX_IN_FLIGHT=32 --namespace inference-prod``` starting canary
oliver: canary looks fine at 60s, queue depth down 30% on canary nodes. proceeding to full rollout
oliver: disabling streaming for embeddings route: `route-config patch embeddings-hosted --set streaming=false --reason 'mitigation: reduce KV attach latency'`
oliver: disabled streaming for embeddings route ✅
maya: monitoring p50/p95 latency and 5xx. dashboards show 5xx dropped from 12% -> 2.1% in 5m after changes. queue depth trending down
jess: posting support banner and DMing affected customers now. draft: "We're seeing increased error rates in us-west-2; we've applied temporary throttles and runtime changes to stabilize performance. You may see brief rate-limits or disabled streaming for embeddings. We'll notify when fully resolved." anything to add?
eva: add ETA to revert changes: target 30m reassess, full revert after 1h if stable
maya: agree. set incident note: mitigation window 15m shaper + runtime changes. revert target 1h.
ryan: I'm taking follow-up for the next 2 hours. maya handing off. key checks: sustained 5xx <1% and p95 latency within normal bounds
maya: handing off to @ryan. will update the incident doc with action items/commands run. nice quick work team :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied (traffic-shaper, max_in_flight reduction, streaming disabled on embeddings). Severity downgraded to P3. Next update scheduled +30m.``
